model: DW Performance Series 4-piece Shell Pack with 22 inch Bass Drum
description: 4-piece Maple Shell Pack with 10' and 12' Toms, 16' Floor Tom, and 22' Bass Drum - Black Diamond FinishPly
product_info: The Performance Series begins with DW's US-built, handcrafted HVX hard rock North American maple shells. The HVX grain orientation arranges wood plies horizontally, vertically, and diagonally for a deep and satisfying fundamental. Shells are baked in pressure molds (2600 PSI at 200°F) then immediately Cool Tempered to crystallize the glue, maximizing strength, roundness, and resonance. Toms come crowned with pinpoint 45° back-cut bearing edges to enhance attack and increase head response; the kick drum features 60° edges for richer depth and effortless playability.

model: Mapex Saturn VI Studioease 5-piece Shell Pack
description: 5-piece Maple/Walnut Shell Pack with 10' and 12' Toms, 14' and 16' Floor Toms, and 22' Bass Drum - Exotic Natural Burl
product_info: The Mapex Saturn VI Studioease shell pack blends time-honored maple/walnut shells with bleeding-edge shell technology borrowed from the Black Panther Design Lab — not to mention a jaw-dropping high-gloss lacquer finish to match any timekeeper's taste! Each piece in this set has been molded to meet the needs of stage and studio professionals. You get thin, 6-ply hybrid shells crowned with Mapex's precision SONIClear bearing edges, Remo USA heads, and Mapex Power Hoops to deliver great tone and tuneability from day one. You also get Mapex's advanced shell venting, suspension tom mounting, and floating SAS floor tom legs for excellent note length and projection. Factor in those iconic Saturn Series badges and lugs, and the Mapex Saturn VI Studioease shell pack proves itself a top contender in every category.

description: 5-piece Poplar Drum Set with 10' and 12' Toms, 16' Floor Tom, 22' Bass Drum, 14' Snare, Hardware, and 2-piece Cymbal Pack - Aqua Blue Glitter
product_info: The Pearl Roadshow makes a solid foundation for the budding drummer and a mighty club kit for the weekend warrior. It's a great-sounding set of drums on its own — its 6-ply poplar shells with modern 45-degree bearing edges deliver a modern, lively attack that's inspiring behind the kit and easy to capture with a mic. This complete 5-piece kit includes drums, cymbals, hardware — even sticks and a stick bag

model: Sonor AQ1 Stage 5-piece Shell Pack with Hardware
description: 5-piece Birch Shell Pack with 10' and 12' Rack Toms, 16' Floor Tom, 22' Bass Drum, 14' Snare, and Complete Hardware Pack
product_info: Expertly crafted by their stalwart engineers in Bad Berleburg, Germany, Sonor’s AQ1 Stage 5-piece Shell Pack and hardware bundle embodies value and sonic versatility. Centered on 100% birch shells, the AQ1 Stage offers a sound that is balanced and highly shapeable. An updated Smart Mount tom system reduces hardware clutter and optimizes resonance with a splendid visual elegance that will look good in any performance space or recording studio. What about stands and pedals? An included 2000 Series hardware pack supplies you with all the goods to get you playing as fast as possible. Drummers here at Sweetwater know great value when they see it, and the AQ1 Stage 5-piece Shell Pack certainly fits the bill!

model: Tama Superstar Classic CL72S 7-piece Shell Pack with Snare Drum
description: 7-piece Maple Shell Pack with 8/10/12' Toms, 14/16' Floor Toms, 22' Bass Drum, and 14' Snare Drum
product_info: TAMA's signature thin 100% maple shells endow the Superstar Classic with bold, rich tones to awaken your grooves and power your backbeats. Low-mass, low-profile lugs reduce weight on the shells for enhanced resonance across the board. And TAMA's Star-Mount system gives you unbeatable openness from your high toms without stands. Sweetwater knows TAMA enthusiasts will appreciate this Superstar Classic's matching maple bass drum hoops and classic TAMA T-badges.

model: Yamaha SBP8F3 Stage Custom Bop 3-piece Shell Pack
description: 3-piece Birch Shell Pack with 12' Tom, 14' Floor Tom, and 18' Bass Drum
product_info: From the DNA of Yamaha's world-famous Recording Custom comes the all-birch Yamaha Stage Custom Bebop shell pack. This little kit is perfect for jazz, hip-hop, and light session work. Its thin 100% birch shells, in vibey bop sizes and complete with low-mass lugs and a lacquer finish, are free to resonate with warm, clear tones. Yet players of all stripes will revel in the birch's crisp snap and dry, cutting crack. Whether you're looking for an authentic bop kit or a travel-friendly stage companion, the Yamaha Stage Custom Birch Bebop shell pack aims to please.
